jobs.description:
About Our Client
Acteur historique de l'immobilier suisse depuis plus de 125 ans, deRham ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son développement et souhaite renforcer son organisation afin d'accompagner ses ambitions de croissance et de transformation.
Dans ce contexte, deRham recrute un-e Directeur-trice des Ventes, chargé-e de piloter l'ensemble des activités transactionnelles du groupe (résidentiel, ventes sur plan, haut de gamme et immobilier de rendement), tout en portant une réflexion prospective sur l'évolution du marché immobilier suisse, tant sur ses segments traditionnels que premium.
Au-delà de la performance commerciale, l'enjeu est de contribuer au repositionnement durable de l'activité transactionnelle en anticipant les évolutions du marché (digitalisation, nouveaux usages, attentes clients, durabilité) et en développant une offre différenciante.

Job Description
Rattaché-e au CEO, vous prenez la responsabilité de la Direction des Ventes et pilotez l'ensemble des activités transactionnelles du groupe. Vous définissez et mettez en œuvre la stratégie commerciale, développez les équipes et accompagnez l'évolution de l'activité dans un marché en constante mutation.
À ce titre, vous avez pour principales missions de :
• Développer les activités sur les segments stratégiques (résidentiel haut de gamme, immobilier de rendement, ventes sur plan) et renforcer la performance commerciale.
• Structurer une organisation performante, orientée client et résultats.
• Accompagner l'évolution de l'offre et des pratiques en intégrant les transformations du marché.
Leadership et management
• Diriger, fédérer et développer les équipes de vente.
• Piloter le P&L de l'activité.
• Instaurer une culture de performance, de collaboration et d'exigence.
• Accompagner le développement des collaborateurs et les recrutements.
Stratégie commerciale
• Définir et déployer la stratégie de développement de l'activité.
• Analyser les évolutions du marché immobilier suisse et adapter les orientations commerciales.
• Prioriser les segments de croissance et développer les partenariats.
• Suivre les indicateurs de performance (chiffre d'affaires, marges, portefeuille).
Développement des affaires
• Obtenir et piloter des mandats stratégiques.
• Développer et entretenir des relations avec une clientèle institutionnelle et privée (investisseurs, promoteurs, family offices, clients privés).
• Mobiliser votre réseau pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
Organisation et évolution de l'activité
• Optimiser les processus, les outils de pilotage et les pratiques commerciales.
• Favoriser l'utilisation des solutions digitales, de la data et du CRM afin d'améliorer la performance et l'expérience client.
• Contribuer à l'évolution de l'offre en lien avec les mutations du secteur.
Coordination
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les autres directions du groupe.
• Coordonner les partenaires externes intervenant sur les opérations de promotion.
• Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction générale.

The Successful Applicant
Expérience et compétences
• Expérience confirmée dans la vente et le courtage immobilier en Suisse (idéalement 10 à 15 ans).
• Solide expérience en développement commercial, négociation de transactions et management d'équipes avec responsabilité P&L.
• Excellente connaissance d'au moins un des segments suivants : résidentiel haut de gamme, immobilier de rendement ou ventes sur plan.
• Réseau professionnel établi auprès des principaux acteurs du marché.
Vision stratégique
• Bonne compréhension des évolutions du marché immobilier suisse et de leurs impacts sur les activités de transaction.
• Capacité à intégrer les enjeux liés à la digitalisation, aux nouveaux usages, à la durabilité et aux attentes des clients dans la stratégie commerciale.
• Capacité à conjuguer vision stratégique et exécution opérationnelle.
Leadership
• Leadership fédérateur et orienté résultats.
• Style de management collaboratif, favorisant l'autonomie et le développement des équipes.
• Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'initiative et excellentes qualités relationnelles.
Critères spécifiques
• Réputation irréprochable (références, extrait du casier judiciaire et de l'Office des poursuites requis pour l'inscription au Registre du Commerce).
• Aisance dans un environnement entrepreneurial et une structure à taille humaine.

What's on Offer
Une opportunité unique de façonner un rôle qui allie direction commerciale et construction d'une vision stratégique du secteur, courant comme premium, ceci dans de bonnes conditions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul nostro cliente
Da oltre 125 anni, il deRham ha aperto un nuovo capitolo nel suo sviluppo e vuole rafforzare la sua organizzazione per sostenere le sue ambizioni di crescita e trasformazione.
In questo contesto, deRham recluta un Direttore Vendite, responsabile della gestione di tutte le attività transazionali del gruppo (residential, plan sales, high-end sales and real estate performance), riflettendo in prospettiva sull'evoluzione del mercato immobiliare svizzero, sia sui suoi segmenti tradizionali che premium.
Oltre alle prestazioni commerciali, la sfida consiste nel contribuire al riposizionamento sostenibile dell'attività transazionale anticipando gli sviluppi del mercato (digitalizzazione, nuovi usi, aspettative dei clienti, sostenibilità) e sviluppando un'offerta differenziata.

Descrizione del lavoro
In allegato al CEO, si assume la responsabilità per le vendite e gestire tutte le attività transazionali del gruppo. Definisci e implementa la strategia aziendale, sviluppi i team e accompagni l'evoluzione del business in un mercato in continua evoluzione.
Come tale, i vostri compiti principali sono:
• Sviluppare attività su segmenti strategici (high-end residenziale, prestazioni immobiliari, vendite di piani) e rafforzare le prestazioni aziendali.
• Struttura un'organizzazione efficiente, orientata al cliente e orientata ai risultati.
• Sostenere l'evoluzione dell'offerta e delle pratiche integrando le trasformazioni di mercato.
Leadership e gestione
• Leader, federazione e sviluppare team di vendita.
• Pilota della P&L dell'attività.
• Creare una cultura di performance, collaborazione e domanda.
• Sostenere lo sviluppo del personale e il reclutamento.
Strategia commerciale
• Definire e distribuire la strategia di sviluppo aziendale.
• Analizzare l'evoluzione del mercato immobiliare svizzero e adattare le linee guida aziendali.
• Iniziare segmenti di crescita e sviluppare partnership.
• Monitorare gli indicatori di performance (dati aziendali, margini, portafoglio).
Sviluppo delle imprese
• Ottenere e pilota mandati strategici.
• Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni con clienti istituzionali e privati (investitori, promotori, uffici familiari, clienti privati).
• Mobilitare la rete per identificare nuove opportunità.
Organizzazione ed evoluzione dell'attività
• Ottimizzare processi, strumenti di pilotaggio e pratiche aziendali.
• Promuovere l'utilizzo di soluzioni digitali, dati e CRM per migliorare le prestazioni e l'esperienza del cliente.
• Contribuire all'evoluzione dell'offerta in relazione ai cambiamenti del settore.
Coordinamento
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con altri rami del gruppo.
• Coordinare i partner esterni coinvolti nelle operazioni di promozione.
• Assicurare una regolare segnalazione alla Direzione Generale.

Il candidato di successo
Esperienza e competenze
• Esperienza confermata in vendita e brokeraggio immobiliare in Svizzera (da 10 a 15 anni).
• Forte esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, nella negoziazione di transazioni e nella gestione del team con la responsabilità P&L.
• Ottima conoscenza di almeno uno dei seguenti segmenti: high-end residenziale, prestazioni immobiliari o vendita piano.
• Rete professionale stabilita tra i principali operatori di mercato.
Visione strategica
• Buona comprensione degli sviluppi nel mercato immobiliare svizzero e del loro impatto sulle attività di transazione.
• Capacità di integrare i problemi relativi alla digitalizzazione, ai nuovi usi, alla sostenibilità e alle aspettative dei clienti nella strategia aziendale.
• Capacità di combinare la visione strategica con la consegna operativa.
Leadership
• Unificare la leadership e i risultati orientati.
• Stile di gestione collaborativo, promuovendo l'autonomia e lo sviluppo dei team.
• Spirito imprenditoriale, senso di iniziativa e qualità relazionali eccellenti.
Criteri specifici
• reputazione impeccabile (riferimenti, estratti dal verbale penale e dall'Ufficio delle Prosecuzioni necessarie per la registrazione nel Registro del Commercio).
• Esperienza in un ambiente imprenditoriale e una struttura di dimensioni umane.

Cosa c'è in Offerta
Un'occasione unica per modellare un ruolo che combina la direzione commerciale e la costruzione di una visione strategica del settore, in esecuzione come premio, questo in buone condizioni.

• To support the evolution of supply and practices by integrating market transformations.

• Contribute to the evolution of supply in connection with the changes in the sector.

• Work closely with other branches of the group.
• Coordinate external partners involved in promotion operations.
• Ensure regular reporting to the Directorate General.

Experience and skills
• Experience confirmed in sales and real estate brokerage in Switzerland (ideally 10 to 15 years).

• Ability to integrate issues related to digitalization, new uses, sustainability and customer expectations into business strategy.

• Unifying leadership and results oriented.
• Collaborative management style, promoting the autonomy and development of teams.
• Entrepreneurial spirit, sense of initiative and excellent relational qualities.

• Impeccable reputation (references, extract from the criminal record and the Office of Prosecutions required for registration in the Trade Register).
• Experience in an entrepreneurial environment and a human-sized structure.

What's on Offer
A unique opportunity to shape a role that combines commercial direction and construction of a strategic vision of the sector, running as premium, this in good conditions.

• Optimieren Sie Prozesse, Pilotierungswerkzeuge und Geschäftspraktiken.

• Beitrag zur Entwicklung des Angebots im Zusammenhang mit den Veränderungen in diesem Sektor.

Der erfolgreiche Bewerber
Erfahrung und Fähigkeiten
• Erfahrung in der Verkaufs- und Immobilienvermittlung in der Schweiz bestätigt (idealerweise 10 bis 15 Jahre).
• Starke Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung, Transaktionsverhandlungen und Teammanagement mit P & L-Verantwortung.
• Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der folgenden Segmente: High-End-Wohnung, Immobilienperformance oder Planverkauf.
• Professionelles Netzwerk unter den wichtigsten Marktteilnehmern etabliert.
Strategische Vision
• Gutes Verständnis für die Entwicklungen auf dem Schweizer Immobilienmarkt und ihre Auswirkungen auf die Transaktionsaktivitäten.
• Fähigkeit, Themen im Zusammenhang mit Digitalisierung, neuen Anwendungen, Nachhaltigkeit und Kundenerwartungen in die Geschäftsstrategie zu integrieren.
• Fähigkeit, strategische Vision mit operativer Umsetzung zu kombinieren.
Führung
• Führung und ergebnisorientiert vereinen.
• Collaborative Management-Stil, Förderung der Autonomie und Entwicklung von Teams.
• Unternehmergeist, Eigeninitiative und ausgezeichnete Beziehungsqualitäten.
Spezifische Kriterien
• Ein tadelloser Ruf (Referenzen, Auszug aus dem Strafregister und die für die Registrierung im Handelsregister erforderliche Staatsanwaltschaft).
• Erfahrung in einem unternehmerischen Umfeld und einer menschengroßen Struktur.

Was ist im Angebot
Eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, eine Rolle zu gestalten, die die kommerzielle Ausrichtung und den Aufbau einer strategischen Vision des Sektors kombiniert, die als Premium läuft, dies unter guten Bedingungen.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a leading international financial services platform operating across multiple jurisdictions and serving a broad network of institutional clients, including banks, asset managers, insurance companies and pension funds.
As a regulated financial institution in Switzerland, the business operates within a highly governed environment and combines the stability of an established market participant with the agility and entrepreneurial mindset of a growing international organisation.
To support its continued development, our client is seeking an experienced Compliance Director to join its Swiss operation.

Job Description
Reporting to the Global Head of Compliance and working closely with the local executive leadership team, the Compliance Director will be responsible for overseeing the compliance framework of the Swiss regulated entity while supporting wider regional compliance initiatives.
This is a stand-alone senior compliance role offering significant autonomy, visibility and exposure to both local and international stakeholders.Key responsibilities include:
• Maintaining and enhancing the firm's compliance framework and control environment.
• Monitoring regulatory developments and ensuring timely implementation of applicable requirements.
• Acting as a primary point of contact with Swiss regulatory authorities and external auditors.
• Providing advice and guidance on regulatory, conduct and compliance matters to senior management and business stakeholders.
• Overseeing AML, KYC and broader financial crime compliance activities.
• Managing compliance monitoring, risk assessments and regulatory reporting processes.
• Supporting audits, regulatory reviews and remediation initiatives.
• Leading and contributing to strategic, regulatory and business transformation projects.
• Collaborating closely with Legal, Risk, Operations, HR and business functions to promote a strong culture of compliance.

The Successful Applicant
• Minimum 10 years of compliance experience within a regulated financial services environment.
• Strong knowledge of Swiss financial market regulation and practical experience interacting with regulatory authorities.
• Experience gained within asset management, wealth management, banking, securities, fintech, wealthtech or other regulated financial institutions.
• Solid expertise across compliance monitoring, governance, AML and KYC frameworks.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of a broad compliance remit.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.
• Pragmatic and commercially minded approach while maintaining high regulatory standards.
• Fluent English is required; additional European languages would be advantageous.
The successful candidate will be a hands-on compliance professional who enjoys operating in a lean environment and is equally comfortable managing strategic regulatory matters and day-to-day compliance responsibilities.

What's on Offer
• A visible and influential compliance leadership role within a successful international financial services organisation.
• Direct exposure to senior executives, global leadership teams and regulatory stakeholders.
• Broad responsibility covering Swiss regulatory matters and regional compliance initiatives.
• A collaborative, entrepreneurial and internationally focused working environment.
• Significant autonomy and ownership within a growing business.
• Competitive compensation package, including an attractive performance-related bonus.
• The opportunity to play a key role in the continued development of a dynamic and well-established organisation.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a well-established international consumer products company with a portfolio of premium brands and a strong market presence. As part of a larger corporate group undergoing continuous transformation and growth, the organization is focused on driving operational excellence, enhancing performance, and strengthening cross-functional collaboration.
To support its next phase of development, our client is seeking an experienced and business-oriented Chief Financial Officer to act as a strategic partner to the General Manager and contribute to long-term value creation.

Job Description
• Lead the Finance, Controlling, Accounting, and Administrative functions of the organization.
• Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting processes.
• Manage investment planning and capital expenditure monitoring.
• Ensure the timely preparation, review, and consolidation of financial statements.
• Monitor and analyze financial performance, including costs, margins, profitability, and operational efficiency indicators.
• Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision-making.
• Partner with senior leadership to identify opportunities for value creation and business improvement.
• Lead, develop, and mentor the Finance and Administration team.
• Ensure effective treasury, cash flow, risk management, and compliance processes.
• Drive finance transformation initiatives, process improvements, and digitalization projects.
• Contribute to cross-functional and group-wide strategic projects.
• Serve as a key member of the leadership team and provide support to executive management when required.

The Successful Applicant
• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field, complemented by relevant professional qualifications.
• Approximately 15 years of progressive experience in finance leadership positions, including significant exposure to operational and commercial business environments.
• Trilingue candidates required: fluency in English, in German and in Italian. Only trilingual candidates can be considered
• Proven track record as a hands-on finance executive with strong expertise in financial performance management, cost optimization, cash flow management, and profitability improvement.
• Strong business partnering capabilities, with experience influencing strategic decisions and supporting organizational growth.
• Experience within manufacturing, industrial, consumer products, or similarly operational environments is highly desirable.
• Deep understanding of operational drivers, cost structures, margin analysis, and performance improvement initiatives.
• Strong knowledge of modern ERP systems and advanced financial analysis tools
• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, excellent analytical skills, and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.

What's on Offer
• Opportunity to join a successful and growing organization with ambitious development objectives.
• Strategic leadership role with significant influence on business performance and future direction.
• Exposure to a dynamic and international environment with close interaction with senior decision-makers.
• Ability to drive meaningful transformation, optimization, and value creation initiatives.
• Attractive employment package aligned with the responsibilities of the position.
• Collaborative corporate culture that values leadership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is an international consumer-focused organization with a strong heritage, established brands, and operations across multiple global markets.
As part of an ambitious transformation and growth journey, the company is making significant investments in its commercial, digital, and customer acquisition capabilities to accelerate growth and strengthen its market position. The business offers a dynamic international environment where innovation, data-driven decision making, entrepreneurial thinking, and commercial impact are highly valued.

Job Description
We are seeking a commercially minded Head of Performance Marketing & Growth to lead customer acquisition and performance-driven growth initiatives across international markets.
This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on performance marketing expertise and requires an individual who is equally comfortable shaping marketing investment decisions, optimizing acquisition performance, evaluating marketing effectiveness, and identifying new opportunities to drive sustainable and profitable growth.
The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and executing the organization's performance marketing strategy across multiple channels and geographies, ensuring that significant media investments generate measurable business impact. Acting as the internal expert on customer acquisition and marketing effectiveness, the role will work closely with commercial, digital, analytics, CRM, and regional teams to build best-in-class performance marketing capabilities and accelerate business growth globally.
• Define and execute the global performance marketing and customer acquisition strategy across international markets.
• Manage and optimize significant digital media investments across multiple channels and regions.
• Drive customer acquisition, revenue growth, and marketing efficiency through data-driven investment decisions.
• Lead performance across key acquisition channels including Paid Search, SEO, Paid Social, Display, Video, YouTube, Affiliate Marketing, and emerging growth channels.
• Establish performance measurement frameworks, attribution models, incrementality testing approaches, and marketing effectiveness methodologies.
• Evaluate channel effectiveness and continuously reallocate investments based on commercial impact, customer value, and profitability.
• Identify growth opportunities across markets and develop scalable acquisition strategies.
• Monitor customer trends, platform developments, and emerging technologies to maintain a competitive advantage.
• Translate complex performance data into actionable business recommendations for senior stakeholders.
• Partner with commercial, CRM, analytics, finance, and regional teams to drive execution and business results.
• Contribute to the development of marketing capabilities, governance, processes, and best practices across the organization.
• Lead and develop high-performing teams as well as external agency and technology partners.

The Successful Applicant
• 10+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, Digital Acquisition, Customer Acquisition, Digital Commerce, or related disciplines.
• Proven track record of managing significant digital media investments and delivering measurable business growth through performance marketing.
• Deep expertise across customer acquisition channels, including:
• Paid Search (Google Ads, Shopping, Performance Max)
• Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
• Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and other relevant platforms)
• Display Advertising
• Video & YouTube
• Affiliate and Partnership Marketing
• Strong understanding of attribution, incrementality testing, marketing measurement, customer lifetime value, ROAS, CAC, and marketing effectiveness.
• Experience within consumer-oriented industries such as consumer goods, retail, fashion, lifestyle, digital commerce, subscription businesses, hospitality, or similar sectors.
• Demonstrated success developing and executing acquisition strategies across multiple markets.
• Strong commercial acumen and the ability to balance growth ambitions with profitability objectives.
• Analytical mindset with a highly data-driven approach to decision making.
• Exposure to international markets and cross-border initiatives.
• Experience working in matrix organizations and influencing senior stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, execution-focused mindset.
• Fluent English.

What's on Offer
• A high-impact role with responsibility for shaping theorganization's global performance marketing and growth agenda.
• The opportunity to contribute to an international transformation and growth journey.
• Ownership of significant marketing investments and strategic growth initiatives.
• Exposure to senior decision makers and international stakeholders.
• A collaborative, entrepreneurial, and performance-driven environment.
• Long-term development opportunities within a growing and evolving organization.
• One day of home office per week.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client, a well-established Swiss private bank with a long-standing heritage in wealth management, is seeking an experienced Senior Private Banker to join its growing teams in multiple locations .
This is an opportunity for entrepreneurial banking professionals with an established network and portable client relationships to join a highly reputable Swiss institution that offers autonomy, flexibility, and direct access to decision-makers.

Job Description
• Acquire, develop and manage a portfolio of High Net Worth (HNW) and Ultra High Net Worth (UHNW) clients.
• Build long-term client relationships through tailored wealth management solutions.
• Identify new business opportunities and drive assets under management growth.
• Deliver comprehensive investment, wealth planning and advisory solutions.
• Ensure full compliance with Swiss and cross-border regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate closely with investment specialists and senior management to deliver best-in-class client service.

The Successful Applicant
• Minimum 10 years of proven success as a Private Banker / Relationship Manager in Switzerland .
• Strong and stable track record of client acquisition and relationship management.
• Demonstrable network within Switzerland, Europe and/or the Middle East .
• Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products and wealth management solutions.
• Excellent knowledge of Swiss and cross-border regulations.
• CWMA-SAQ certification or equivalent qualification preferred.
• Entrepreneurial, self-driven and capable of working independently.
• Resident in Switzerland or eligible to work in Switzerland.
• We are particularly interested in professionals covering:
•
• Switzerland
• Western and Northern Europe
• Southern Europe
• Middle East (GCC markets especially welcomed)

What's on Offer
• The stability and reputation of an established Swiss private banking platform.
• A genuinely entrepreneurial environment with substantial autonomy.
• Direct access to senior leadership and swift decision-making processes.
• Competitive and direct performance-driven remuneration structure.
• Flexible and supportive platform for experienced bankers looking to grow their business.
• Long-term commitment to relationship-driven private banking.

jobs.description:
About Our Client
Our client is a renowned luxury player located in the German-speaking region of Switzerland and part of a growing international group with ambitious expansion plans. The group is actively pursuing strategic growth opportunities, including future acquisitions, and is seeking an exceptional General Manager to lead this flagship property while contributing to the broader development of the organization.
This is an outstanding opportunity for an entrepreneurial luxury hospitality leader who combines commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and operational excellence with a passion for delivering world-class guest experiences.
The successful candidate will be a highly visible leader, equally comfortable engaging with guests, motivating teams, driving financial performance, and participating in strategic business decisions. Beyond leading the hotel, this individual will have the opportunity to grow within the organization and play an increasingly significant role as the group expands.

Job Description
Leadership & Strategy
• Lead the overall strategic and operational direction of the hotel.
• Develop and execute initiatives that strengthen market positioning, guest satisfaction, and financial performance.
• Drive a culture of excellence, accountability, innovation, and luxury service.
• Act as a trusted partner to ownership and the executive leadership team.
• Contribute to group-wide strategic projects, acquisitions, and growth initiatives.
Operational Excellence
• Ensure flawless delivery across all areas of the hotel operation.
• Maintain the highest standards of luxury hospitality and personalized guest service.
• Lead by example through a visible, hands-on management style.
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency, and guest engagement.
Commercial & Financial Leadership
• Assume full responsibility for the property's financial performance and P&L.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting, business planning, and performance management.
• Drive revenue growth and profitability through strong commercial leadership.
• Apply rigorous financial discipline while maintaining exceptional guest experiences.
• Identify opportunities for value creation and operational optimization.
People & Culture
• Recruit, develop, and retain top hospitality talent.
• Build and mentor a high-performing leadership team.
• Foster a culture of engagement, ownership, and professional development.
• Create a workplace environment that reflects the values of excellence and collaboration.
Brand & Stakeholder Management
• Serve as ambassador for the hotel within the local market and internationally.
• Build strong relationships with guests, owners, business partners, and community stakeholders.
• Represent the hotel and the group at industry events and within relevant networks.

The Successful Applicant
A sophisticated luxury hotel leader with Swiss roots, international perspective, strong financial acumen, entrepreneurial drive, and a genuine passion for hospitality -someone who leads from the front, thinks strategically, delivers results, and has the potential to grow into a larger regional or group leadership role as the organization expands.
Experience
• Proven success as a General Manager or senior executive within a luxury or ultra-luxury hospitality environment.
• Strong international exposure gained through leading properties, brands, or teams within internationally recognized hospitality organizations.
• Demonstrated experience driving business performance and operational excellence.
• Experience within a growing hospitality platform, multi-property environment, or international hotel group is highly desirable.
• Exposure to acquisitions, integrations, hotel openings, or repositioning projects would be advantageous.
Professional Competencies
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify and capitalize on growth opportunities.
• Excellent strategic thinking combined with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.
• Outstanding commercial instincts and business judgment.
• Strong financial acumen with proven P&L responsibility and a deep understanding of hotel financial management.
• Ability to balance luxury service excellence with operational and financial performance.
• Skilled at managing complexity, change, and stakeholder expectations.
Leadership Style
• Inspirational, authentic, and highly visible.
• Hands-on operator who remains close to guests, employees, and the business.
• Confident decision-maker with strong emotional intelligence.
• Collaborative leader capable of building trust across cultures and functions.
• Ambitious and eager to take on broader responsibilities as the organization grows.
Languages
•
• Additional languages such as French or Italian are an asset.

What's on Offer
• Opportunity to lead a flagship luxury property.
• Exposure to strategic growth and expansion projects.
• Long-term career development within an ambitious international hospitality group.
• Dynamic, high-performance, and collaborative work environment.

Informazioni sul nostro cliente
Il nostro cliente è un noto giocatore di lusso situato nella regione di lingua tedesca della Svizzera e parte di un gruppo internazionale in crescita con piani di espansione ambiziosi. Il gruppo sta attivamente perseguendo opportunità di crescita strategica, comprese le acquisizioni future, e sta cercando un General Manager eccezionale per guidare questa proprietà di punta, contribuendo allo sviluppo più ampio dell'organizzazione.
Questa è un'occasione eccezionale per un leader di ospitalità di lusso imprenditoriale che combina acume commerciale, pensiero strategico e eccellenza operativa con la passione per la fornitura di esperienze ospiti di livello mondiale.
Il candidato di successo sarà un leader altamente visibile, ugualmente confortevole coinvolgendo con gli ospiti, motivando i team, guidando le prestazioni finanziarie e partecipando a decisioni strategiche di business. Oltre a guidare l'hotel, questo individuo avrà l'opportunità di crescere all'interno dell'organizzazione e svolgere un ruolo sempre più significativo come il gruppo si espande.

Descrizione del lavoro
Leadership e strategia
• Guidare la direzione strategica e operativa generale dell'hotel.
• Sviluppare ed eseguire iniziative che rafforzano il posizionamento del mercato, la soddisfazione degli ospiti e le prestazioni finanziarie.
• Guidare una cultura di eccellenza, responsabilità, innovazione e servizio di lusso.
• Agire come partner affidabile per la proprietà e il team dirigente esecutivo.
• Contribuire a progetti strategici di gruppo, acquisizioni e iniziative di crescita.
Eccellenza operativa
• Assicurare una consegna impeccabile in tutte le aree dell'operazione alberghiera.
• Mantenere i più alti standard di ospitalità di lusso e servizio personalizzato per gli ospiti.
• Guida per esempio attraverso uno stile di gestione visibile e pratico.
• Identificare costantemente le opportunità per migliorare la qualità, l'efficienza e l'impegno degli ospiti.
Leadership commerciale e finanziaria
• Assumere la piena responsabilità per le prestazioni finanziarie della proprietà e P&L.
• Lead budgeting, previsione, pianificazione aziendale e gestione delle prestazioni.
• Aumentare la crescita dei ricavi e la redditività attraverso una forte leadership commerciale.
• Applicare rigorosa disciplina finanziaria pur mantenendo eccezionali esperienze degli ospiti.
• Identificare opportunità di creazione di valore e ottimizzazione operativa.
Persone e cultura
• Recluta, sviluppa e conserva i migliori talenti di ospitalità.
• Costruire e mentore un team di leadership altamente performante.
• Promuovere una cultura di impegno, di proprietà e di sviluppo professionale.
• Creare un ambiente di lavoro che rispecchia i valori di eccellenza e collaborazione.
Gestione dei marchi e degli stakeholder
• Servire come ambasciatore per l'hotel nel mercato locale e a livello internazionale.
• Costruire relazioni forti con gli ospiti, i proprietari, i partner commerciali e le parti interessate della comunità.
• Rappresentare l'hotel e il gruppo in eventi del settore e all'interno di reti pertinenti.

Il candidato di successo
Un sofisticato leader di hotel di lusso con radici svizzere, prospettiva internazionale, forte acume finanziario, impulso imprenditoriale, e una vera passione per l'ospitalità -qualcuno che guida dal fronte, pensa strategicamente, offre risultati, e ha il potenziale di crescere in un ruolo di leadership regionale o di gruppo più grande come l'organizzazione si espande.
Esperienza
• Risultato successo come General Manager o senior executive all'interno di un ambiente di ospitalità di lusso o ultra-lusso.
• Forte esposizione internazionale acquisita attraverso le principali proprietà, marchi o team all'interno di organizzazioni di ospitalità riconosciute a livello internazionale.
• Esperienza dimostrata che guida le prestazioni aziendali e l'eccellenza operativa.
• L'esperienza all'interno di una crescente piattaforma di ospitalità, ambiente multi-property, o gruppo di hotel internazionale è altamente auspicabile.
• L'esposizione a acquisizioni, integrazioni, aperture di hotel o progetti di riposizionamento sarebbe vantaggiosa.
Competenze professionali
• Forte mentalità imprenditoriale con la capacità di identificare e capitalizzare sulle opportunità di crescita.
• Eccellente pensiero strategico combinato con un approccio pragmatico e pratico.
• Istinto commerciale eccezionale e giudizio d'affari.
• Forte acume finanziario con comprovata responsabilità P&L e una profonda comprensione della gestione finanziaria alberghiera.
• Capacità di bilanciare l'eccellenza del servizio di lusso con prestazioni operative e finanziarie.
• Abilitato nella gestione delle aspettative di complessità, cambiamento e stakeholder.
Stile di Leadership
• Ispirativo, autentico e altamente visibile.
• Operatore manuale che rimane vicino a ospiti, dipendenti, e il business.
• Un decisore fiducioso con una forte intelligenza emotiva.
• Leader collaborativo capace di costruire fiducia in culture e funzioni.
• Ambizioso e desideroso di assumere responsabilità più ampie man mano che l'organizzazione cresce.
Lingue
•
• Altre lingue come il francese o l'italiano sono un bene.

Cosa c'è in Offerta
• Opportunità di condurre una proprietà di lusso di punta.
• Esposizione a progetti di crescita strategica e di espansione.
• Sviluppo di carriera a lungo termine all'interno di un ambizioso gruppo di ospitalità internazionale.
• Ambiente di lavoro dinamico, ad alte prestazioni e collaborativo.

About Our Client
Our client is an international well-known asset manager based in Zurich.

Job Description
Regulatory & Compliance Leadership
• Serve as the designated Head of Compliance under Swiss financial market regulations and maintain accountability for the Swiss compliance framework.
• Act as the primary contact for FINMA, regulatory auditors, and internal audit on all supervisory matters, regulatory reviews, filings, and remediation activities.
• Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Compliance Management Framework, including risk assessments, policies, monitoring, training, and reporting.
• Act as Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and lead the management of compliance incidents, investigations, and integrity-related matters.
• Monitor and assess regulatory developments and ensure timely implementation of relevant Swiss regulatory requirements.
Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management
• Act as a strategic partner to the business, balancing commercial objectives with regulatory and conduct risk considerations.
• Lead, develop, and inspire a high performing Legal & Compliance team of 4 headcounts
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.
• Support strategic initiatives, new business developments, and organizational change from a legal and compliance perspective.
Legal Advisory & Governance
• Serve as the principal legal advisor to Swiss business activities, providing pragmatic and commercially focused legal guidance.
• Review, negotiate, and advise on a broad range of commercial, regulatory, corporate, and financial services agreements, including investment management, outsourcing, distribution, licensing, vendor, and intra-group arrangements.
• Ensure global legal documentation, policies, and frameworks are adapted and compliant with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements.
Advise senior management, governance committees, and the Board on legal, regulatory, governance, and risk-related matters.

The Successful Applicant
• Swiss law degree or equivalent
• 8-15 years of experience in legal and/or compliance roles within asset management industry in Switzerland
• Proven stakeholder management skills, advantage to have leadership experience
• Deep knowledge of Swiss financial market regulation, including FinSA, FinIA, CISA, AMLA, and FINMA regulatory requirements.
• Strong understanding of European financial services regulation, including MiFID, UCITS and related frameworks.
• Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial and financial services agreements.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior executives and Boards.
• Strong judgment, integrity, and ability to operate independently in a complex, international environment.
• Interest in technology enabled ways of working, including AI and process optimization initiatives
• Fluent in English and German.

What's on Offer
• A highly visible leadership role with direct exposure to FINMA, senior management, and the Board.
• The opportunity to shape the Swiss Legal & Compliance strategy within a leading international asset manager.
• A collaborative, global environment with strong influence on governance, risk management, and business decisions.

Description de l'emploi
Leadership en matière de réglementation et de conformité
• Servir de chef désigné de la conformité en vertu de la réglementation suisse sur les marchés financiers et maintenir la responsabilité du cadre de conformité suisse.
• Agir comme premier contact pour la FINMA, les vérificateurs réglementaires et la vérification interne sur toutes les questions de surveillance, les examens réglementaires, les dépôts et les activités d'assainissement.
• Superviser la mise en oeuvre, le maintien et l'amélioration continue du Cadre de gestion de la conformité, y compris les évaluations des risques, les politiques, la surveillance, la formation et les rapports.
• Agir en tant qu'agent de signalement du blanchiment d'argent et diriger la gestion des incidents de conformité, des enquêtes et des questions liées à l'intégrité.
• Surveiller et évaluer l'évolution de la réglementation et assurer la mise en œuvre en temps voulu des exigences réglementaires suisses pertinentes.
Partenariat d'affaires et gestion des intervenants
• Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique de l'entreprise, en établissant un équilibre entre les objectifs commerciaux et les considérations réglementaires et en tenant compte des risques.
• Dirigez, développez et inspirez une équipe de 4 têtes juridiques et de conformité performante
• Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, d'amélioration continue et de perfectionnement professionnel.
• Appuyer les initiatives stratégiques, les nouveaux développements commerciaux et le changement organisationnel dans une perspective juridique et de conformité.
Conseil juridique et gouvernance
• Servir de conseiller juridique principal pour les activités commerciales suisses, en fournissant des conseils juridiques pragmatiques et axés sur le commerce.
• Examiner, négocier et donner des conseils sur un large éventail d'ententes de services commerciaux, réglementaires, corporatifs et financiers, y compris la gestion des investissements, l'externalisation, la distribution, l'octroi de licences, le fournisseur et les ententes intragroupe.
• Veiller à ce que la documentation, les politiques et les cadres juridiques mondiaux soient adaptés et conformes aux exigences juridiques et réglementaires suisses.
Conseiller la haute direction, les comités de gouvernance et le Conseil sur les questions juridiques, réglementaires, de gouvernance et liées au risque.

Le candidat retenu
• Diplôme de droit suisse ou équivalent
• 8-15 ans d'expérience dans les rôles juridiques et/ou de conformité dans le secteur de la gestion d'actifs en Suisse
• Compétences éprouvées en gestion des intervenants, avantage d'avoir une expérience de leadership
• Connaissance approfondie de la réglementation suisse des marchés financiers, y compris les exigences réglementaires de FinSA, FinIA, CISA, AMLA et FINMA.
• Une bonne compréhension de la réglementation européenne des services financiers, y compris la MiFID, les OPCVM et les cadres connexes.
• Expérience de la rédaction, de l'examen et de la négociation d'accords complexes sur les services commerciaux et financiers.
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication, avec la capacité d'influencer les cadres supérieurs et les conseils.
• Fort jugement, intégrité et capacité à fonctionner de façon indépendante dans un environnement international complexe.
• L'intérêt pour la technologie a permis de travailler, y compris les initiatives d'IA et d'optimisation des processus
• En anglais et en allemand.

Ce qui est en offre
• Un rôle de leadership très visible avec une exposition directe à la FINMA, à la haute direction et au conseil.
• L'occasion de façonner la stratégie Swiss Legal & Compliance au sein d'un leader mondial des actifs.
• Un environnement collaboratif et mondial ayant une forte influence sur la gouvernance, la gestion des risques et les décisions des entreprises.
